No subject family covers metric names, and none of the free-form families (protocol-behavior, api-endpoint, migration) can hold it without changing how it is spelled.; change: The evidence lists a metric rename (old name -> envoy_cilium_npds_control_plane_pending_requests) under 'Changed Metrics'. A 'renamed' change needs a replacedBy in the same family, and there is no family for metrics.; applicability: An environment is exposed if its dashboards, alerts or queries use the old metric name. No configuration predicate can read that, and the evidence does not state an exposure condition.; consequence: The upgrade note only lists the old and new metric names.
